review_candidates.description: Company Description Mac Construction, part of MAC GROUP, is dedicated to creating timeless landmarks through smart construction and innovative design. The company focuses on delivering high-quality urban development projects that blend functionality, sustainability, and aesthetic value. Team members contribute to impactful projects that shape urban environments and enhance community living spaces. Role Description The Information Technology Application Specialist for urban planning is a full-time, on-site role based in Heliopolis. The specialist will provide day-to-day application and technical support for planning, design, and construction-related software used across project teams. Responsibilities include troubleshooting application issues, managing user access and configurations, coordinating system updates, and ensuring data integrity and availability for planning workflows. The role will work closely with engineers, planners, and project managers to translate business processes into effective technology solutions, optimize system performance, and support training and documentation for end users. The specialist will also assist in evaluating new tools, integrating applications, and aligning IT capabilities with the company’s urban planning and construction objectives. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to diagnose issues, interpret data, and improve application performance. Candidates should possess Application Support and Technical Support skills to maintain, configure, and troubleshoot planning and construction software. Candidates should possess Information Technology skills, including familiarity with enterprise systems, databases, and basic networking concepts. Candidates should possess Business Process understanding to map workflows, document requirements, and align applications with operational needs. Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Experience supporting applications in construction, urban planning, or engineering environments is highly beneficial. Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Ability to work on-site in Heliopolis and manage multiple support requests and projects in a fast-paced environment.
